title: pmoves.bootstrap/v1
description: Session-bootstrap CGP profile for PMOVES-aware agents. Carries the agent's identity, available tools + MCPs, service tags (Tailscale/RustDesk/Hostinger/Cloudflare), routing to peer agents, and operational constraints. Aligned to the canonical CHIT Geometry Packet spec at pmoves/docs/PMOVESCHIT/CGP_v1.0_SPECIFICATION.md - the same envelope (spec/meta/sig/super_nodes/...) but with pmoves.bootstrap/v1 as the profile name and super_nodes: [] (empty geometry payload - the bootstrap is metadata, not a data packet). The consumer forks (PMOVES-hermes-agent, PMOVES-pinokio) read this once at init, then run on their existing engines; this is a manifest, not a config replacement.

spec.description: Profile identifier. Fixed at pmoves.bootstrap/v1 for this schema. The forks MUST treat any other spec value as unknown and refuse to consume.

meta.description: Bootstrap metadata. Mirrors the CGP v1.0 meta block (source/units_mode/K/bins/backend analog for bootstrap context: bootstrap_id/operator/source/created_at/encoder_version).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this CGP was produced.

operator.description: Operator handle - the human in the loop (e.g. darkxside).

source.description: Which producer emitted this CGP - typically mavis (the Mavis harness loader) but also hermes/pinokio if a consumer re-emits with its identity block updated.

encoder_version.description: Semver of the producer that emitted this CGP. Consumers should log a warning if a newer minor is seen.

bootstrap_id.description: Optional stable identifier for the bootstrap session (UUID4 recommended). When absent, consumers can derive one from the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON.

sig.description: Optional HMAC signature (same shape as CGP v1.0 sig). If CHIT_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE is set on the consumer, the sig MUST be valid or the consumer refuses the CGP. For now, signing is advisory - the bootstrap CGP is not a security boundary, just a manifest.

kid.description: Key identifier (16-char tag from the producer's CHIT manifest).

identity.description: The identity of the agent session loading this CGP. Drives which Mavis voice/skin/role is active; tells the consumer fork who it's acting as in the multi-agent fleet.

role.description: Functional role for this session. The harness picks the role; the consumer fork may further narrow it (e.g. Hermes-as-critic).

skin.description: Voice/skin/identity surface from the persona system (per pmoves/configs/agent-profiles/). Optional - consumers can fall back to the agent's default.

tools.description: PMOVES tools available in this session. Each tool is a string identifier that the consumer fork resolves against its own tool registry. Missing tools are silently skipped (the consumer is non-breaking - the operator's tag 'tagged-services-are-advisory' applies here too).

mcps.description: MCP servers loaded for this session. Identifiers are the same ones in .claude/mcp.json / pmoves/tools/ subagent configs.

services.description: Tagged services - hints to the consumer fork about which infrastructure surfaces are reachable. None of these are required; missing services are just skipped, not failed. additionalProperties:false on the top-level services object so typo'd service names (e.g. 'tnailscale' instead of 'tailscale') are caught at the schema level rather than silently passing through.

tailscale.description: Tailscale tailnet identity. host is the tailnet name; ip is the device's tailnet IP (100.x.y.z).

rustdesk.description: RustDesk device fleet. devices is a list of human-readable device handles the operator's RustDesk client knows about.

hostinger.description: Hostinger website. status is advisory - 'pending-mgmt' means the operator hasn't managed it yet; 'managed' means the website is live and the consumer can publish to it.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare account handle. account is the CF account ID; zones is optional (list of zone IDs the consumer can deploy to).

routing.description: Where to find the other agents in the fleet. Mavis publishes tasks to pmoves.agent.task.v1 with target=<agent>; the matching agent subscribes and returns on pmoves.agent.result.v1. additionalProperties:false on the top-level routing object so typo'd agent names are caught at the schema level.

kiloclaw.description: The KiloCode / GLM-5.1 coding agent. Lives on the 5090 node per memory; subscriber is the KiloCode process the operator already has running.

hermes.description: The NousResearch Hermes agent. Node is TBD until the operator stands Hermes up. The harness sets up the wire anyway so when Hermes subscribes, the routing is ready.

constraints.description: Operational constraints the consumer fork MUST honor. These are the non-breaking guarantees - consumers that violate a constraint are broken, not the producer.

items.description: Constraint identifiers. The set is open - new constraints can be added in minor versions.

super_nodes.description: CGP-valid geometry payload. The bootstrap CGP has no geometry (the bootstrap is metadata, not a data packet), so this MUST be the empty array. Producers that want to include geometry should emit a CGP v1.0 packet instead.
